notes.title: New ship names, minor graphics fixes
notes.content:
The ships you can build have new, much-more-informative names!
[list]
[*] Gatherer
[*] Crafter
[*] Trader
[*] Harvester
[*] Builder
[*] Medic
[*] Fighter
[*] Striker
[/list]

- Added slight rotation to background stars
- Made Striker's texture have more violet to distinguish it better
- Fixed a resource node that didn't have a texture
- Fixed missing planet explosions

notes.title: Resource, graphics & story updates!
notes.content:
- Resources now gravitate slowly towards the planet so that they might collected automatically

- The background starmap texture now rotates slowly to give a sense of being in space

- Reduced chance of encountering story based events on the world map

notes.title: New ship models!
notes.content:
- We've updated the AI ship models to something more artistically consistent and spiffy 😀

- Also fixed a bug where you could only get dialog-based story missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38730673/37f7d2a2f8e354af7f78d16b17b9faf2f2ac9dc5.png[/img]

Let us know what you think on the forums!

notes.title: Added Story Scenes to the world map!
notes.content:
Added Story Scenes to the world map! These choices impact your stats and resources. Let's take choosing your own adventure to the next level!

[i]Check out the top-down sci-fi fantasy shooter with strategy, building and resource management. Colonize, build stations and recruit allies as you fly your ship through limbo![/i]
